name: Push Film
description: Both clips run through a film strip: the second pushes the first out of the frame like a film moving through a projector. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Where the clips move: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down

params.name: strip
params.description: Width of the perforated band on each side, relative to the frame

params.name: gap
params.description: Gap between two pictures of the strip, relative to the frame

params.name: holes
params.description: Perforations per picture on each side
